summary: Alterity Therapeutics, a Melbourne-based clinical-stage biotech listed on ASX and NASDAQ, furnished a Form 6-K attaching its Appendix 4C quarterly cash flow report and corporate update for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Disclosures cover FDA End-of-Phase 2 minutes confirming the Phase 3 design and registrational pathway for ATH434 in Multiple System Atrophy, a new U.S. composition-of-matter patent extending protection to 2045, a peer-reviewed bioMUSE publication, and a A$41.3 million cash balance. The filing notes continued evaluation of strategic funding and partnering alternatives, but announces no transaction, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor. Watch for future partnering or financing announcements as Phase 3 start-up proceeds.
